status: Requalification of the pinned observer mod on Claude Code 2.1.295 with the 2.1.291 capability profile unchanged; see docs/decisions/D-0009-claude-2.1.295-observer-requalification.md and evidence/M2/.

stableSessionIdentity.basis: Full native session IDs from `claude agents --json --all` (M0B). In the mod, classic.SessionStart carries the engine-stamped session_id, equal to $.session.id() and to session.end's sessionId and resume id in every native run; clear/resume/compact are tracked as logical changes without deleting identity.
refs: test: provenance and identity > logical session changes (session.end clear, classic.SessionStart clear and resume)

nativeTurnIdentity.basis: turn.start mints turnId; every turn.step and the turn.complete of that turn carry it; a subagent's run carries its own turnId on steps and completion, with no turn.start (declaration lines 12982-12993, 12903-12906; native runs 1-3).

nativeTurnOutcome.basis: turn.complete reason answer|aborted|refusal|error with isAborted and agentId, dispatched with next.origin engine/core and a settled core link (coreSettled true natively). A plugin cannot raise turn.complete through $ in 2.1.291. Natively exercised: reason answer (main loop and subagent); aborted, refusal and error rest on the declaration and pass unchanged in the kit. Stop-veto/automatic-continuation behaviour is not qualified here.
refs: test: provenance and identity > plugin-raised lifecycle-shaped events cannot forge a native outcome
test: middleware contract > event passed unchanged

exactRequestIdentity.basis: Not qualified. The mod sees tool.check (a permission preflight that can also be answered by a classifier or headless host) with a decision and tool_use_id, not a native identity for an open human request; PermissionRequest carries no tool_use_id (SPEC §11.2).

aggregateHumanWait.basis: Not qualified by this profile's evidence. The source is native inventory waitingFor (SPEC §11.3); M0B qualified inventory identity but not the waitingFor mapping, and the mod exposes no wait state.

liveInventory.basis: `claude agents --json --all` supplies live sessions with full sessionId, pid and status without a prompt or hook (M0B).

replayableTurnHistory.basis: Not qualified. The mod observes live callbacks only; transcript files are not a stable API (SPEC §11.3), and records unacknowledged at a reload or host exit are lost (native run 2: 13 records).

immediateParentIdentity.basis: agent.spawn carries the spawning loop as parentAgentId (absent for the main loop) and, from a spawn that settled in core, the started agentId; the subagent's turn.step/turn.complete carry that agentId. A spawn answered by a lower middleware leaves coreSettled false and establishes nothing. Natively exercised at depth 1 (main loop -> general-purpose subagent); nested spawns rest on the declaration and the kit.
refs: test: provenance and identity > agent.spawn provenance requires a settled core trace

currentSessionProcessLookup.basis: Session -> current ProcessKey join with stable birth time, executable and controlling device (M0B).

supportedSurfaces.basis: The mod loaded and observed natively in headless `claude -p` (single prompt and long-lived stream-json with plugin-folder watch). Interactive terminal sessions were not started in this qualification; Desktop Code, VS Code, remote and cloud surfaces are not qualified (SPEC §11.6).

engineDispatchOrigin.field: next.origin (host-stamped { plugin, tier }; the engine reads { plugin: "engine", tier: "core" })
evidence: test: provenance and identity > plugin-raised lifecycle-shaped events cannot forge a native outcome
native runs 1-3: engine/core on every prompt.submit

originalComposerOrBridgeOrigin.field: prompt.submit e.origin: PromptOrigin, kinds composer | bridge | sdk | task-notification | scheduled-trigger | peer | ... | plugin; set by the engine where queued, no hook may set one
evidence: test: provenance and identity > upstream middleware cannot rewrite prompt origin
test: provenance and identity > accepted-human core-acceptance proof for prompt.submit
originalComposerOrBridgeOrigin.nativeNote: composer is not exercised natively (no interactive session); sdk and task-notification were observed natively.

settledCoreAcceptanceProof.field: next.trace after next(e) resolves: last entry { plugin: "engine", tier: "core", outcome: returned|passed } and a result without drop
evidence: test: provenance and identity > engine dispatch origin alone does not prove downstream core execution
native runs 1-3: coreSettled true on every prompt.submit

acceptedInputProvenance.retained: Only { links, endPlugin, endTier, endOutcome, coreSettled }, outcome and the origin kind/name; no prompt text or full trace.
acceptedInputProvenance.limits: A hook above the observer (another user-tier plugin or a managed prepend plugin) can still delay or hide a submission before the observer sees it.

automaticHumanFollowupResolution.reason: 2.1.291 exposes no positive original-order witness: prompt.submit carries text, attachments, context, turnId (the turn running at submission, absent when idle), wait and origin, but no original-submission sequence, timestamp or predecessor relation; session.append keeps row timestamps off the event; telemetry loggedAt is wall time on an untyped, operator-only stream; the observer's own capture counters do not order upstream-delayed dispatches.
automaticHumanFollowupResolution.fallback: Explicit Mark handled resolves a previous output; a follow-up prompt never clears it automatically. Native outcomes, identity, actors and exact current-session Return are unaffected.

unavailableCapabilities.uiMeaning: A previous-output attention item stays until the owner presses Mark handled; replying to the session does not clear it.
An approval or input wait is shown as a session-level category episode, not as one named pending request.
No waiting badge comes from this profile; the session shows reported activity until the inventory waitingFor mapping is qualified.
Turns before observation began, or records lost across a mod reload or host exit, are not reconstructed; the timeline shows a coverage gap.

classicLimitedFallback.when: The mod is absent, fails to load or validate, or the build's generated declarations name another version.
classicLimitedFallback.behaviour: Safe command hooks plus native inventory: sessions are still discovered and native reported activity/waits shown, but no definitive per-turn outcome and no accepted-human provenance is inferred from weaker fields (SPEC §11.1).

observedSemantics.dispatchOrigin: Every engine-raised event natively carried next.origin { plugin: "engine", tier: "core" } and a one-link trace ending in the engine's core.
observedSemantics.pluginRaisedLifecycle: The plugin-facing $ declares turn as { abort } and session without start/end; a plugin's $.turn.start/step/complete and $.session.start/end are not functions at run time.
observedSemantics.hostReads: $.agent.list() and $.session.id() are middleware-interceptable and return bare values without provenance; kept at a lower tier.
observedSemantics.sessionStartOrder: Natively classic.SessionStart(startup) fires before the mod's session.start; after a hot reload session.start fires again and classic.SessionStart does not.
observedSemantics.reload: A hot reload runs register in a fresh environment with a new source epoch and drops the old environment's pending $.clock waits and unacknowledged records.
observedSemantics.toolTurnLink: tool.call carries tool_use_id and agentId but no turnId.
observedSemantics.spawn: In headless -p the Agent tool ran in the background; its completion re-entered as prompt.submit with origin task-notification.

installation.capturedArgvFrom: userConfig captureArgv (settings pluginConfigs["threadspace-observer" | "threadspace-observer@inline"].options, read from user, --settings or managed settings; never project settings)
installation.loadSideEffect: Each load from a person-owned folder writes .claude-plugin/types/ (with its own .gitignore) and a root tsconfig.json into the mod folder.
installation.ownedCopy: <integration dir>/observer/<sha256 prefix>/, staged by Threadspace --integration install (SPEC 19.2)

generatedBesideMod.observedIn: the Threadspace-owned mod copy loaded by the M2 vertical session
